title: One masterclass format for the whole series
question: One masterclass format for the whole series

frame.problem: We need one repeatable format before producing the series. Do we build the series on a single masterclass format?

vars.name: Production speed
vars.ctx: A single format lets the playbook and the editor get faster each time.

vars.name: Learner outcomes
vars.ctx: The format must work for decision-making topics of different depth.

vars.name: Brand consistency
vars.ctx: The series must be recognisable at a glance.

opts.name: One format for all
opts.desc: Same structure, length and visual style for every masterclass.
